title: Make The Time

sections.markdown:
![Make The Time](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/t/e5c1cc5dec1d4e26ad797ab5d646eb5d.png?m=638566664434670000)

Liaison officer, U.S. Marine Corps Capt. Jurgen Campbell (Retired in 2026), and Chief Advisor, Navy Capt. Tara N. Smith, both at Prevention and Response Behavioral Programs speak about the importance of building a relationship with your fellow service member to help increase mental health.

Video by John Martinez | Communication Directorate
